div.div:
Notes
*1 The shared file layer sits outside a run
An AWS HealthOmics run gets its shared file system (run storage) from the service. FSx for ONTAP is a candidate where you supply the shared layer (AWS Batch on EC2, your own HPC, on premises).
*2 The two frames are deliberately not joined
Whether a HealthOmics run can take an FSx for ONTAP S3 Access Point as input is unverified.
*3 FlexCache with a non-AWS ONTAP service as Origin is unverified
